### AI declaration
Every feature/fix pull request must include an AI-contribution declaration for the code introduced or substantially modified by that pull request.
The declaration must use one of the following levels:
- No substantial AI-generated code
- Below 50% AI-generated
- 50% or more AI-generated

If AI-generated code was used, the declaration should identify the source files in the pull request that received substantial AI assistance.
For example:
AI contribution: 50% or more
AI-assisted files:
- src/auth/service.ts
- src/auth/validation.ts
